primitives.name: Oddsmaker Shading
primitives.verbatim_quote: Schlicht (Oct 2017)* - **The Football & Betting Reality**: - Sportsbooks and oddsmakers do **not** set point spreads to be purely predictive of the final score margin.
primitives.assumptions: Point spreads reflect economic equilibrium rather than pure predictive value; retail bettors exhibit systematic biases.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When public action distorts pricing beyond predictive utility.

layer2.mapping: Maps market price distortions to calibrated edge thresholds via GSE's pass-discipline rule.
layer2.telemetry: Spread deviation from predictive baseline, public handle imbalance.

primitives.name: Trench Pressure Strain
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Pass pressure as a binary stat** (did a sack/hurry occur?) rather than a continuous spatio-temporal strain accumulating in the pocket.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'time in seconds', 'x': 'spatial coordinates in yards', 'V(x,t)': 'potential field of pocket disruption (dimensionless)', '\\rho(x,t)': 'pressure density (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Pressure evolves continuously over time and space; binary metrics omit temporal accumulation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When discrete stats fail to capture evolving pocket vulnerability.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphs to fluid dynamics models of pressure propagation in offensive line disruption.
layer2.telemetry: Cumulative pressure index per play, real-time pocket integrity score.

primitives.name: Defensive Coverage Static
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Defensive coverage as a static pre-snap look** (2-high vs 1-high) rather than dynamic post-snap rotation and disguise.
primitives.assumptions: Coverage assignment is fixed pre-snap; dynamic adjustments are ignored.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When post-snap coverage shifts invalidate static classification.

layer2.mapping: Maps static coverage schemes to expected pass success rates using historical drive data.
layer2.telemetry: Pre-snap coverage type, post-snap rotation frequency.

Defensive coverage static reflects a failure to account for post-snap rotations, leading to misclassification of risk.
